"""Prepare a fresh finite phase only after the actual safe end of v7."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.rolling_production_queue import no_calling
from tools.production_window_gate import inspect_window
previous='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7';following='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v8'
folder=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production';old_path=folder/(previous+'.json');old=read_json(old_path)
assert old['machine_id']==machine_id() and old['status']=='stopped_at_safe_boundary'
assert old['reason']=='bounded_transport_or_run_duration','No automatic continuation after user/auth/uncertain stop'
assert not (folder/'owner.json').exists()
assert read_json(folder/(previous+'-released-owner.json'))=={'run_id':previous,'machine_id':machine_id()}
assert not (folder/(following+'.json')).exists()
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists()
no_calling(ROOT)
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/retry-scheduler/state.json')['pending'] is None
assert inspect_window(ROOT,old['after_window'],machine_id())['ready']
plan=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json')['batches'];assert 0<=old['next_index']<=len(plan)
count=png=content=auth=0
for path in (ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-window-timings').glob(previous+'-window*-completed.json'):
 receipt=read_json(path);assert receipt['status']=='completed'
 resolved=[e for e in receipt['events'] if e['phase']=='image_resolved'];count+=len(resolved)
 png+=sum(e['error'] is None for e in resolved)
 content+=sum('moderation_blocked' in (e['error'] or '') for e in resolved)
 auth+=sum('token_expired' in (e['error'] or '') for e in resolved)
assert count==old['completed_source_requests'] and count==png+content+auth
spec={'runId':following,'startIndex':old['next_index'],'afterWindow':old['after_window'],'maxCalls':64,'maxPreviewBytes':6553600,'maxRunSeconds':7200}
spec_path=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v8-spec-20261025.json';assert not spec_path.exists()
audit_path=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v8.json';assert not audit_path.exists()
write_json(spec_path,spec)
write_json(audit_path,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'previous_run':previous,'previous_state':old,'previous_state_sha256':file_sha256(old_path),'previous_actual_invocations':count,'previous_actual_PNG_returns':png,'previous_content_refusals':content,'previous_authentication_errors':auth,'following_run':following,'following_spec':spec,'following_spec_sha256':file_sha256(spec_path),'status':'following_finite_run_prepared_owner_not_yet_claimed','user_scope':'Continue explicitly authorized LOW production using built-in imagegen; skip service-refused HIGH without clearing incomplete counts or retry consumption.','scope':'New finite transport phase only after cell654 actually finished, up to64 planned requests or2h. Prior v7 counts/deadline/receipts remain unchanged; resume actual cursor/after-window without replay. Existing a/root output reviewers only, b agent stopped. In-flight old review groups may finish; no old deadline reset. Prior unique Git-only publisher must actually finish/read back/release its lock before any new publisher starts; generation continues independently.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'prepared':True,'spec':spec,'previous_actual_invocations':count,'previous_PNGs':png,'previous_content_refusals':content,'previous_authentication_errors':auth,'new_image_calls':0,'owner_claimed':False},ensure_ascii=True))

"""Root producer observes a finite source group while the two reviewers review PNGs."""
import json,os,re,sys,uuid
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.fresh_source_observation_queue import candidates,extract_original
from PIL import Image
folder=ROOT/'runtime/fresh-source-observations'
owner=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')
run=owner['run_id'];assert re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+',run)
assert owner['machine_id']==machine_id()
state=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')
assert state['status']=='running' and state['machine_id']==machine_id()
assert not (ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}-stop-requested.json').exists()
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists()
for p in (folder/'allocations').glob('*.json'):
    old=read_json(p)
    if old['slot']=='producer':assert (ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-fresh-observation-completions/{old["tag"]}.json').exists(),'Unfinished producer original observation; reconcile before allocating more'
plan=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json')['batches']
prepared=sum(len(read_json(ROOT/item['jobs'])) for item in plan[state['next_index']:])
intended=sum(len(read_json(p).get('expected_source_keys',[])) for p in (ROOT/'runtime/production-queue/preparation/pending').glob('*.json'))
assert prepared+intended<=8,'Useful prepared supply exists; do not over-reserve originals'
tag='fresh-observed-'+datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')+'-producer-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
selected=[];reserved=folder/'reservations';reserved.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for item in candidates(ROOT):
    path=reserved/(item['key']+'.json')
    try:fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL)
    except FileExistsError:continue
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        item=extract_original(ROOT,item)
        json.dump({'machine_id':machine_id(),'slot':'producer','tag':tag,'reserved_at_utc':utc_now(),'source':item},stream,ensure_ascii=True)
    selected.append(item)
    if len(selected)==4:break
assert selected,'No unreserved allowed original; do not fabricate one'
allocation=folder/'allocations'/(tag+'.json');assert not allocation.exists()
body={'machine_id':machine_id(),'slot':'producer','tag':tag,'created_at_utc':utc_now(),'sources':selected,
    'producer_supply_context':{'run_id':run,'next_index':state['next_index'],'prepared_requests':prepared,'pending_preparation_requests':intended},
    'scope':'One finite group of original inputs actually observed by the root generation executor during its service/queue wait. Existing a/b portrait reviewers remain the only two output-review slots. No new agent, output approval, image call, retry claim, journal preparation or canonical portrait write. Atomic shared source reservations prevent duplicate claims; normal complete and sole-producer preparation gates remain mandatory.'}
write_json(allocation,body)
views=[]
for item in selected:
    with Image.open(item['original']) as opened:
        image=opened.convert('RGBA');alpha=image.getchannel('A').getextrema()
        target=ROOT/f'runtime/{tag}-{item["key"][:8]}-nearest4.png'
        image.resize((image.width*4,image.height*4),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(target)
        views.append({'key':item['key'],'path':item['original'],'sha256':item['original_png_sha256'],'size':list(image.size),'alpha_extrema':list(alpha),'nearest_path':str(target),'nearest_sha256':file_sha256(target)})
result={'tag':tag,'allocation':allocation.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'allocation_sha256':file_sha256(allocation),'config':f'runtime/{tag}-observations.json','sources':selected,'views':views,'created_at_utc':body['created_at_utc'],'mascot_reference_sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/'mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png')}
write_json(ROOT/'runtime/producer-originals-current-20261025.json',result)
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=True))

"""Record actual v8 owner and start a separate finite phase in the same b slot."""
import hashlib,json,shutil,sys
from datetime import datetime,timedelta
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v8';assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
production=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json');assert production['status']=='running'
prior=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v7-phase.json');assert prior['current_tag'] is None and prior['completed_groups']==6
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/slot-b.json')['status']=='available'
now=utc_now();phase={'machine_id':machine_id(),'run_id':run,'operator':'Codex root in existing b slot, b agent stopped','created_at_utc':now,'deadline_utc':(datetime.fromisoformat(production['created_at_utc'])+timedelta(seconds=7200)).isoformat(),'max_groups':16,'completed_groups':0,'current_tag':None,'current_kind':None,'previous_phase_preserved':prior,'scope':'Independent finite v8 phase in same slot after v7 actual completion. No new reviewer/agent, no prior deadline reset; finish allocated group at boundary.'}
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v8-phase.json';assert not phase_path.exists()
files=['runtime/prepare-low-v8-continuation-20261025.py','runtime/resume-low-v8-built-in-20261025.js','runtime/producer-originals-claim-20261025.py','runtime/producer-originals-complete-20261025.js','runtime/record-low-v8-started-20261025.py']
for stem in ['next','finalize','originals-finalize']:
 old=ROOT/f'runtime/root-review-slot-b-{stem}-v7-20261025.py';new=ROOT/f'runtime/root-review-slot-b-{stem}-v8-20261025.py';assert not new.exists()
 source=old.read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert source.count('root-b-review-v7-phase.json')==1
 new.write_text(source.replace('root-b-review-v7-phase.json','root-b-review-v8-phase.json'),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n');files.append(new.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
old=ROOT/'runtime/root-review-slot-b-verify-v7-20261025.py';new=ROOT/'runtime/root-review-slot-b-verify-v8-20261025.py';assert not new.exists()
source=old.read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert 'resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7' in source
new.write_text(source.replace('resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7',run),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n');files.append(new.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
sources=[{'path':p,'sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/p),'source':(ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8')} for p in files]
for row in read_json(ROOT/'runtime/low-v7-in-memory-sources-20261025.json')['sources']:
 sources.append({**row,'sha256_utf8':hashlib.sha256(row['source'].encode()).hexdigest(),'role':'Same unchanged in-memory functions used by sole builtin exec711; completion only prepares actually observed source intent.'})
archive=ROOT/'docs/handoffs/2026-10-25-low-v8-helper-sources.json';assert not archive.exists()
write_json(phase_path,phase);write_json(archive,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':now,'actual_builtin_exec_cell':711,'sources':sources,'scope':'Actual source archive for recovery only, not permission to start another producer or replay requests. v7 publisher failed on remote rebase, under audited isolated reconciliation; no new publisher started.'})
target=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v8-started.json';assert not target.exists()
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':now,'run_id':run,'actual_builtin_exec_cell':711,'production_state_observed':production,'previous_v7_actual_end':read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7.json'),'previous_v7_actual_calls':36,'previous_v7_PNGs':35,'previous_v7_content_refusals':1,'previous_v7_authentication_errors':0,'root_b_phase':phase,'source_archive':archive.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'source_archive_sha256':file_sha256(archive),'capacity':{'observed_at_utc':now,'free_bytes':shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free,'retention_review_at_utc':'2026-10-29T10:30:00Z','cleanup_performed':False,'protection_renewed':False,'bounded_generation_only':True},'Git_only_publisher':'Old5372 stopped; isolated remote rebase/fullsize-index reconciliation under real validation. No v8 publisher started and no raw verification claim for pending images.','scope':'Actual new finite builtin phase follows v7 safe stop and owner release after actual exec654 completed. No image replay, service channel change or old retry/cooldown reset. a/root remain two existing output reviewers, b agent stopped. Prior source observations after actual views use millisecond timestamps. New review phase deadline derives from actual v8 owner creation, not this record time.'})
print(json.dumps({'audit':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'archive':archive.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'phase':phase,'free_bytes':shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free},ensure_ascii=True))

"""Guard and normally allocate the existing b slot to root; no extra reviewer."""
import json,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.fresh_source_observation_queue import claim as fresh_claim
from tools.portrait_review_queue import wait_for_claim
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v8-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path)
assert phase['machine_id']==machine_id() and phase['current_tag'] is None
assert phase['completed_groups']<phase['max_groups'] and datetime.now(timezone.utc)<datetime.fromisoformat(phase['deadline_utc'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
run=phase['run_id'];assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
assert read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')['status']=='running'
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists() and not (ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}-stop-requested.json').exists()
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/slot-b.json')['status']=='available'
allocation=fresh_claim(ROOT,'b')
if allocation.get('ready'):
 views=[]
 for item in allocation['sources']:
  with Image.open(item['original']) as opened:image=opened.convert('RGBA')
  target=ROOT/f'runtime/{allocation["tag"]}-{item["key"][:8]}-root-nearest4.png'
  assert not target.exists();image.resize((image.width*4,image.height*4),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(target)
  views.append({'key':item['key'],'path':item['original'],'sha256':item['original_png_sha256'],'size':list(image.size),'alpha_extrema':list(image.getchannel('A').getextrema()),'nearest_path':str(target),'nearest_sha256':file_sha256(target)})
 allocation.update(views=views,mascot_reference_sha256=file_sha256(ROOT/'mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png'));kind='originals'
else:
 assert not allocation.get('stop_requested')
 allocation=wait_for_claim('b',0);kind='portrait'
if allocation.get('ready'):
 phase.update(current_tag=allocation['tag'],current_kind=kind,allocated_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'kind':kind,'allocation':allocation,'finite_phase':phase},ensure_ascii=True))

"""Count a normally completed root b group and preserve its exact evidence."""
import json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

tag=sys.argv[1];assert re.fullmatch(r'rollingb[0-9]+',tag)
receipt=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-review-slot-completions/{tag}.json';done=read_json(receipt)
assert done['status']=='reviewed_and_staged' and done['machine_id']==machine_id()
report=ROOT/done['report'];body=read_json(report);assert file_sha256(report)==done['report_sha256']
slot=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/slot-b.json');assert slot['status']=='available' and slot['last_report']==done['report']
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v8-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path);assert phase['current_tag']==tag and phase['current_kind']=='portrait' and phase['completed_groups']<phase['max_groups']
target=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-review-handovers/20261025-root-{tag}.json';assert not target.exists()
proof=ROOT/f'runtime/root-review-slot-b/{tag}/verified-binding.json';config=ROOT/done['config']

phase.setdefault('completed',[]).append({'tag':tag,'report':done['report'],'report_sha256':file_sha256(report),'completed_at_utc':done['completed_at_utc']})
detail=proof.parent/'actual-detail-crops.json'
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'operator':'Codex root in existing b slot; b agent stopped','report':done['report'],'report_sha256':file_sha256(report),'counts':body['counts'],'slot_completion':receipt.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'slot_completion_sha256':file_sha256(receipt),'actual_review_config':read_json(config),'config_sha256':file_sha256(config),'independent_ordered_builtin_binding':read_json(proof),'binding_proof_sha256':file_sha256(proof),'targeted_actual_pixel_details':read_json(detail) if detail.exists() else [],'finite_phase_after_completion':phase,'finalizer_source':{'path':Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(Path(__file__)),'source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')},'scope':'Actual root observations/decisions, no automatic approval or new slot. Stage/global/complete already succeeded once. Sole running builtin producer applies decisions between imports; all original/raw PNGs remain unchanged.'})
write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'counts':body['counts'],'completed_groups':phase['completed_groups'],'audit':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()},ensure_ascii=True))

"""Independent current source/raw/ordered builtin request verification, no approval."""
import hashlib,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
tag=sys.argv[1];assert re.fullmatch(r'rollingb[0-9]+',tag)
slot=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/slot-b.json');assert slot['status']=='assigned' and slot['tag']==tag and slot['machine_id']==machine_id()
owner=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json');assert owner=={'run_id':'resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v8','machine_id':machine_id()}
assert read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{owner["run_id"]}.json')['status']=='running'
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists() and not (ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{owner["run_id"]}-stop-requested.json').exists()
manifest=ROOT/slot['manifest'];assert file_sha256(manifest)==slot['manifest_sha256']
out=ROOT/f'runtime/root-review-slot-b/{tag}';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
entries=[];reference=ROOT/'mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png';reference_sha=file_sha256(reference)
rows=read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/generated.json')['portraits']
for page in read_json(manifest)['pages']:
 assert file_sha256(Path(page['path']))==page['sha256']
 for e in page['entries']:
  key=e['source_sha256'];source=ROOT/f'runtime/references/{key}.png';raw=ROOT/e['generated_fullsize_image'];row=rows[key]
  assert file_sha256(source)==e['original_png_sha256'] and file_sha256(raw)==e['generated_fullsize_sha256']==row['generated_fullsize_sha256']
  assert file_sha256(ROOT/row['image'])==e['image_sha256']==row['image_sha256']
  journal=ROOT/row['request_journal'];a=next(v for v in read_json(journal)['attempts'] if v['number']==e['attempt_number'])
  assert a['method']=='built-in imagegen' and a['fullsize_sha256']==e['generated_fullsize_sha256']
  dispatch=ROOT/f'runtime/production-queue/dispatch/{key}-{a["number"]:03}.json';d=read_json(dispatch)
  assert d['status']=='returned_image' and d['returned_image_sha256']==e['generated_fullsize_sha256']
  snapshot=Path(d['actual_request_snapshot_file']);assert file_sha256(snapshot)==d['actual_request_snapshot_sha256']==a['actual_request_verification']['actual_request_snapshot_sha256']
  s=read_json(snapshot);assert s['key']==key and s['prompt']==a['prompt'] and hashlib.sha256(s['prompt'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()==d['prompt_sha256']==a['prompt_sha256']
  assert s['transparent']==a['transparent_background'] and a['actual_request_verification']['actual_recorded_before_call'] is True
  paths=s.get('references',s.get('referenced_image_paths',[]));ordered=[file_sha256(Path(p)) for p in paths]
  assert ordered==d['input_sha256'] and ordered[-1]==reference_sha and e['original_png_sha256'] in ordered
  assert file_sha256(Path(d['returned_image']))==e['generated_fullsize_sha256']
  with Image.open(source) as im:si=im.convert('RGBA')
  with Image.open(raw) as im:ri=im.convert('RGBA')
  nearest=out/f'{e["index"]}-source-nearest4.png';si.resize((si.width*4,si.height*4),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(nearest)
  def stats(im):
   alpha=im.getchannel('A');hist=alpha.histogram()
   return {'size':list(im.size),'alpha_extrema':list(alpha.getextrema()),'alpha_counts_252_255':{str(k):hist[k] for k in [252,253,254,255]}}
  entries.append({**e,'source_image':source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'source_stats':stats(si),'raw_stats':stats(ri),'source_nearest4':nearest.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'source_nearest4_sha256':file_sha256(nearest),'journal_sha256':file_sha256(journal),'dispatch_sha256':file_sha256(dispatch),'actual_snapshot_sha256':file_sha256(snapshot),'exact_prompt_sha256':a['prompt_sha256'],'ordered_input_sha256':ordered,'transparent':s['transparent'],'retained_builtin_cache_sha256':file_sha256(Path(d['returned_image'])),'binding_verified':True})
target=out/'verified-binding.json'
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'verified_at_utc':utc_now(),'observer':'Codex root, existing b slot takeover; no new reviewer slot','manifest':slot['manifest'],'manifest_sha256':file_sha256(manifest),'reference_sha256':reference_sha,'entries':entries,'scope':'Fresh independent byte/request verification only, no visual decision or canonical write.
